author: tihsu99
body: #### PR description: A patch for updating the L1 seed used in the Phase-2 `HLT_Photon187` path. The goal is to migrate the L1 seed filtering from the current `L1TTkEmFilter` implementation to the P2GT-based filtering. The new filter uses the `pSingleEGEle51` algorithm from `l1tGTAlgoBlockProducer` for the single photon L1 seed. #### Description of the current changes: The updates include: * Adding `hltEGL1SeedsForSinglePhotonNonIsolatedFilter`, using `HLTP2GTSingleObjectFilter` with the `pSingleEGEle51` P2GT algorithm and `CL2Photons` collection. * Replacing `l1tTkEmSingle51Filter` with the new P2GT-based L1 seed filter in both `HLTPhoton187L1SeededSequence` and `HLTPhoton187UnseededSequence`. * Removing the corresponding `l1tTkEmSingle51Filter` configuration, which is no longer used by the `HLT_Photon187` sequences. #### PR validation: The PR has been prepared starting from `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-1100`: ```bash cmsrel CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-1100 cd CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-17-1100/src cmsenv git cms-init git cms-addpkg HLTrigger/Configuration scram b && scram b code-checks && scram b code-format && scram b ``` #### Phase-2 HLT validation: The HLT efficiencies before and after the PR were compared as a function of $p_T$ in the barrel region using sample `/RelValZEE_14/CMSSW_20_0_0-PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D121_RegeneratedGS_PU_16Aug26-v6/GEN-SIM-RECO` under geometry `ExtendedRun4D121`, and no significant difference was observed.
title: [HLT] replaces the legacy Layer-1 TkEm with P2GT algorithm and its CL
